name: personal-memory
description: Your own long-term memory, kept on your device. Each chat borrows only a few relevant lines, with your consent.
long_description: Personal Memory keeps notes you ask it to keep (how you felt, what happened, what helped, reality anchors, messages to your future self) in one file on your computer. When you talk about yourself, Claude can borrow a tiny, relevant slice (usually under 300 tokens) instead of your whole history. Nothing is saved unless you ask or agree. Notes marked private are never shown to any AI. No account, no cloud, no tracking. Free and open source. Not a medical or therapy product.

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Save something to your memory, only when you ask or agree.

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Borrow a tiny, privacy-filtered slice of your memory relevant to this message.

tools.name: memory_info
tools.description: Status, access log, or export of your memory.

data_dir.title: Memory folder
data_dir.description: Where your memory file is kept. Back up or move this folder any time.

share_sensitive.title: Share notes marked sensitive
share_sensitive.description: Off by default. Notes marked private (restricted) are never shared, whatever this says.

budget.title: Memory per reply (tokens)
budget.description: The most memory Claude may borrow for one reply. Smaller shares less.
